questions.q: In which year did Brainiac first appear, in Action Comics #242?
questions.why: Brainiac debuted in Action Comics #242, cover-dated July 1958, shrinking cities and bottling them.

questions.q: Which writer and artist created Brainiac?
questions.why: Otto Binder wrote and Al Plastino drew the 1958 debut of Brainiac as a Superman villain.

questions.q: In the Superman comic strip that inspired Brainiac, the city-shrinking villain Romado traveled with a white alien monkey named what?
questions.why: The strip's villain Romado had a white alien monkey called Koko, in the story that prefigured Brainiac's debut.

questions.q: Which planet is Brainiac usually said to come from?
questions.why: Most versions show Brainiac as a hyper-intelligent android or cyborg whose home is the planet Colu.

questions.q: Which shrunken Kryptonian capital is the best known of those in Brainiac's collection?
questions.why: Brainiac bottled Kandor, the capital of Krypton, which Superman later keeps in his Fortress of Solitude.

questions.q: What is the distinctive shape of Brainiac's spaceship?
questions.why: Brainiac travels the galaxy in a skull-shaped ship, storing bottled cities he has collected.

questions.q: In his 1961 Silver Age debut, Brainiac 5 claimed to descend from the villain in which century?
questions.why: Brainiac 5 of the Legion of Super-Heroes first said he was Brainiac's 30th-century descendant in Action Comics #276.

questions.q: In a 1964 Superman story, Brainiac is revealed to be a robot built by which group?
questions.why: Superman #167 recast him as a machine produced by the Computer Tyrants of his home planet, built to scout and conquer worlds.

questions.q: Who played Brainiac in the live-action TV series Smallville?
questions.why: James Marsters played Brainiac on Smallville, while Blake Ritson later played him in Krypton.

questions.q: In the post-Crisis comics, what is the name of the Coluan scientist who becomes Brainiac?
questions.why: After the history rewrite he became Vril Dox, a radical scientist whom the computers of Colu condemned to death.
